`class WindowUIBridge`<br/>
**Extends:** [`StackUIBridge`](/reference/backends/stackuibridge/)<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`SnapshotUIBridge`](/reference/testing/snapshotuibridge/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.ui` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [WindowUIBridge.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/ui/WindowUIBridge.java)

The default UI bridge, which clears the window to a color every frame and draws text tooltips.

## Description

The backend registers one when no UI bridge was registered before it.
Get it from `BridgeHandler.UI.getBridge(WindowUIBridge.class)` to set its colors and its tooltip text, as [Style the window bridge](/use/learn/running/backends/#style-the-window-bridge) shows.

## Properties

| Property | Type | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| [background](#WindowUIBridge-property-background) | [`Color`](/reference/drawing/color/) | `Color.BLACK` | Sets the color that clears the window before every frame, behind every UI. |
| [hoverColor](#WindowUIBridge-property-hoverColor) | [`Color`](/reference/drawing/color/) | `Color.decode("#18181b")` | Sets the fill of the tooltip box. |
| [hoverInfo](#WindowUIBridge-property-hoverInfo) | [`TextInfo`](/reference/text/textinfo/) | `null` | Sets the text style of the tooltips; without it, the bridge draws no tooltip and, with the dev jar, prints a warning once. |
| [hoverBorderColor](#WindowUIBridge-property-hoverBorderColor) | [`Color`](/reference/drawing/color/) | `Color.decode("#27272a")` | Sets the color of the border, one design pixel wide, of the tooltip box. |
